description.value: Recreation Inn & Suites is a family-owned hotel situated beside Highway 97 on the edge of Kelowna, offering a range of room types from standard queens to a three-bedroom apartment suite sleeping up to eight. The property features a seasonal outdoor pool, dry sauna, heritage gardens with BBQ and picnic areas, and a complimentary continental breakfast included with every stay. Its location adjacent to parks, an on-leash dog park, and walking-distance restaurants makes it a comfortable and convenient base for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and detailed, confirming a real, open family-owned hotel in Kelowna with active booking functionality and a 2026 copyright. Contact details on the website (phone 250-860-3982, email info@recreationinn.com, address 1891 Parkinson Way) match OSM exactly. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; Wi-Fi and free continental breakfast are explicitly confirmed on the amenities and rooms pages; the front page notes 'a handful of restaurants are all within easy walking distance' supporting nearby evening food.
concerns: OSM name is 'Recreation Inn and Suites' but the website consistently uses 'Recreation Inn & Suites' (ampersand instead of 'and').
Website also advertises a toll-free number 1-800-663-8603 not present in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel in Kelowna with a functioning website and confirmed contact details — straightforward inclusion.
